rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment: maximum allowable rents and annual general adjustment
rules.requirement: Rents on controlled units cannot exceed the Rent Control Board's maximum allowable rent (MAR). Each year the MAR rises by 75% of the regional CPI change, but never less than 0% or more than 3%. Landlords may not raise rent if they are unregistered or have uncorrected housing-code violations.
rules.citation: Santa Monica City Charter art. XVIII, §§ 1804-1805
citation_aliases: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment
rules.quoted_span: in no event shall the general adjustment be less than zero percent or greater than three (3) percent
rules.effective_date_note: Rent control originally enacted 1979; the 0%-3% general adjustment limit (§1805(a)(3)) was amended 11/8/22, effective 12/6/22. That date is used.
rules.key_value: 75% of CPI, min 0%, max 3% annual general adjustment
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential rental units in Santa Monica except exempt units (hotels, institutions, owner-occupied up to 3 units, new construction after adoption of the Article, single family homes per §1815, etc.).
rules.exemptions: Transient hotel/motel units; hospitals, convents, dormitories; certain government-owned units; owner-occupied dwellings of 3 or fewer units; units constructed after adoption of the Article (not conversions); non-profit child care/social service units; single family homes to the extent in §1815 (not in this part). Exemptions are granted by the Board on owner application.
rules.penalty: Landlord who fails to register or comply may not increase rent; tenant may refuse to pay an improperly noticed increase.
rules.conflict_note: Adoption date of the Article is not stated in this document; the April 10, 1979 cutoff is inferred from the 1979 enactment and the April 10, 1979 reference in §1801(n). Single-family exemption (§1815) is outside this part.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner-occupied dwellings with 3 or fewer units

rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment: eviction only for just cause
rules.requirement: A landlord may not demand possession, threaten termination, serve a notice to quit, or sue to recover a controlled unit unless a listed ground applies, such as the tenant's failure to pay the rent lawfully due.
rules.citation: Santa Monica City Charter art. XVIII, § 1806
rules.quoted_span: No landlord shall take action to terminate any tenancy including but not limited, to making a demand for possession of a rental unit, threatening to terminate a tenancy, serving any notice to quit or other eviction notice
rules.effective_date_note: Original 1979 enactment; this part shows only the start of §1806 (grounds after (a)(1) are cut off).
rules.key_value: Eviction of controlled units only on enumerated just-cause grounds
rules.coverage_conditions: Controlled rental units as defined in §1801(c).
rules.exemptions: Same exemptions as controlled rental units under §1801(c).
rules.conflict_note: Text truncated at §1806(a)(2); remaining grounds not in this part.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner-occupied dwellings with 3 or fewer units

rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Charter Amendment: security deposits in interest-bearing accounts
rules.requirement: Security deposits and advance rent on controlled units must be held in an interest-bearing account at a federally insured institution until returned to the tenant or properly used. The landlord may pay the interest to the tenant or use it to offset operating expenses unless the Board orders it paid to tenants.
rules.citation: Santa Monica City Charter art. XVIII, § 1803(s)
rules.quoted_span: shall be placed in an interest bearing account at a federally insured financial institution until such time as it is returned to the tenant or entitled to be used by the landlord
rules.effective_date_note: Effective date of this subsection not stated in this part.
rules.exemptions: Same as controlled rental unit exemptions.
rules.interaction: Board may regulate amount and use of deposits consistent with state law.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner-occupied dwellings with 3 or fewer units

parsed.doc_summary: Part 1 of Santa Monica's Rent Control Charter Amendment (Art. XVIII): definitions and exemptions, Rent Control Board powers, security deposit interest rule (§1803(s)), base rent ceiling and the annual general adjustment of 75% of CPI capped at 0-3% (§§1804-1805), and the start of the just-cause eviction section (§1806).
